items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: we played a million recording dates together

ctx.x: Yes, I'll recall his name in a minute, we played a million recording dates together.

So anyway, Earl Palmer (phonetic spelling) was there and this guy got drunk, and Earl said Ernie, you're going to think Rene's got your money and I said what do you mean, he said well, you thought he was going to do better, him telling you he's going to get a good musician and he comes up
with another liquor head. He said I don't believe they want to play with you.
